tooltip.simplesorter.sorting_wand.1: Right click to sort supported containers around you.
tooltip.simplesorter.sorting_wand.2: 128 effective uses. Durability is only consumed when items actually move.
tooltip.simplesorter.sorting_wand.3: Shift + Right Click opens settings. Each wand stores its own setup.
screen.simplesorter.wand_settings.title: Sorting Wand Settings
screen.simplesorter.wand_settings.subtit: Configure one wand. Run actions directly or save the setup.
jei.simplesorter.sorting_wand.info.1: Right click to sort every supported inventory in the wand's configured radius around the player.
jei.simplesorter.sorting_wand.info.2: Shift + Right Click opens a polished mini GUI for sorting mode, radius, and visual effects.
jei.simplesorter.sorting_wand.info.3: Categories are rule-based: exact item ids, tags, item classes, id tokens, and custom config JSON.
jei.simplesorter.sorting_wand.info.4: Modes: Match Existing, Smart Categories, Compact Stacks, and Player Deposit. Match Existing is safer for normal survival storage.
screen.simplesorter.wand_settings.footer: Shift + Right Click opens this screen. Regular Right Click uses the selected mode.
screen.simplesorter.wand_settings.mode.m: Moves items only into chests that already contain the same item.
screen.simplesorter.wand_settings.mode.s: Exact item match first, then reliable material forms; unknown items stay put.
screen.simplesorter.wand_settings.mode.c: Only merges partial stacks. Does not fill empty slots.
screen.simplesorter.wand_settings.mode.p: Deposits matching items from your inventory into nearby chests.
screen.simplesorter.wand_settings.keys.l: Menu: %s  |  Quick sort: %s  |  Rebind in Minecraft Controls
